headline: Redwood Metals opens new production line in Rotterdam
body: Redwood Metals commissioned a new line at its Rotterdam site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Redwood Metals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Redwood Metals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Redwood Metals on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Redwood Metals, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Redwood Metals appoints new regional sales director
body: Redwood Metals announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Redwood Metals opens new production line in Rotterdam
body: Redwood Metals commissioned a new line at its Rotterdam site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Redwood Metals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Redwood Metals reported revenue growth of 25% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Redwood Metals wins quality award from industry association
body: Redwood Metals received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Redwood Metals signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Redwood Metals announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
